decisions.statement: A row is deleted from the menu the editor draws over that row.
Every test of a row's menu hands in the harness call written beside this page.
An intent is named to the command by its initiative and its statement.
A row's initiative is read off that row's key by the module reading a drag's key.
The statement named is the label the row is drawn under.
A row that is no intent deletes no intent.
Deleting an intent is made by the command taking an intent out.
An initiative is named to the command by the slug its row is keyed by.
A row that is no initiative deletes no initiative.
Deleting an initiative is made by the command taking an initiative away.
Alan is asked to confirm in a modal before an initiative goes.
The modal says the intents go with the initiative and a seat's assignment stays.
An answer other than the confirming word deletes nothing and says nothing.
A deletion waits the ceiling the harness names rather than a ceiling named here.
A deletion that failed is said to Alan once and written to the panel's channel.
The editor is handed in rather than imported.
The harness call is handed in rather than imported.
Each command asked is named by reading the slug off that command's own page.
The panel is told a row is going before the command deleting that row is called.
Alan answers the modal before the panel is told an initiative is going.
The panel is told the row stayed where the command refused.
The panel is told the deletion answered where the command landed the deletion.
A row the command deleted is told to the panel once rather than twice.
The panel is told rather than drawn to.
Alan is not asked to confirm before an intent goes.
Nothing here writes the initiative's page.
Nothing here draws a row.
A refusal saying a body moved between the read and the write is said to Alan as one sentence.
That refusal is known by the module knowing a drop's refusal.
Every other refusal reaches Alan in the words that refusal was made in.

definition: the row Alan deletes in the work tree named to the command that deletes it
